review_scope: Review of retained initial and revised validators plus exported copy manifest; not another native model run.
checks: Revised checker rejects duplicate cell rows and duplicate event labels with ValueError and nonzero process exit.
It compares numeric float32 encoding against every capture and history hex field; mismatches produce failed check and return 1.
It requires exact ordered event sequence, exactly nine matching cells per event, phase continuity and endpoint/history words.

Prior actual runtime and initial offline receipts remain unchanged; original verifier is separately retained and identified by the copy manifest. Revised offline receipt refers to the same actual retained capture and selected words.
99 exported native copy-manifest entries match their files in SHA256 and length.
limits: Offline checker does not independently verify NetCDF input or full history, native mode, bounds, pointers, or timestamp. These are covered separately in the native and independent reviews.
Malformed required fields may raise an exception rather than emit a receipt, but exit nonzero.
bounds_correction: Corrected KDM ite from mistaken 235 (ide) to captured 233; prior bad review preserved outside publication.
